insights.unavailable: Could not read the insights for this page.
insights.noDigest: This page does not render, so it has no shape to report.
insights.imageNoAltFix: Add alt text, or alt="" if it is decorative — an absent attribute and an empty one mean different things to a screen reader.
insights.previewUnavailable: This page cannot be rendered — it has no layout, or no URL to render at.
insights.previewNoLayout: This site binds no page layout to this post type, so it is content other pages use rather than a page of its own. Bind one in the site's post-type layouts to preview it.
insights.previewNotSaved: Rendered from the values on screen. Nothing here is saved.
